facts.fact: The article gives Uganda's digital roadmap a period of 2023 to 2027; its published date 2026-08-13 is used as the as-of and falls inside that period. Text public: not stated

The article says the 2023-2027 digital roadmap includes extending the national backbone to over 73 districts and 20 cities, 95% of government services online, broadband to 90% of the territory and most SMEs connected; no cost is stated; published date 2026-08-13 used as the as-of.

systems.tiers: national backbone, government services, broadband, SMEs

note: The roadmap's targets span infrastructure, state services and SMEs, but the article does not state who adopted it, so class is left empty; its period (2023-2027) differs from other documents' 2023-2028 and 2024-2028.
